def: to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper

occurrences.text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
